reviewed_controls.property: Exclusive index.lock acquired before repeated symbolic HEAD, exact base HEAD, and index identity checks; compare-and-swap branch update follows them. This rejects the previously identified same-base branch switch before lock acquisition.
Selected source files and tracked dirty files are checked before and after activation and are not rewritten by the helper.
Private backup contains original index, coordination, and manifest. New tree is built into a private temporary index without a worktree update; only the expected manifest is replaced.
Coordination writes append only; both postconditions preserve the exact captured original followed by the isolated published appendix.
Exclusive intent/success/failure receipts and phase updates retain recoverable partial-activation evidence. No automatic rollback can overwrite concurrent later state.
DONE prose limits logging03 evidence to admission and launch, explicitly excluding its final compact outcome and performance qualification.

limits: Read-only code review, not an activation execution or fault-injection test.

Git index.lock coordinates normal Git index/checkout operations; it does not serialize arbitrary external direct writes to HEAD or working files. Preservation guards fail visibly on detected concurrent changes.
Abrupt process or host loss can interrupt a multi-file activation; the backup and intent/phase receipts support manual recovery, not an atomic filesystem transaction.
